Trump rejects AI regulation, calls it a 'golden goose'

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has rejected calls for regulating artificial intelligence (AI), describing it as a "golden goose." He argued against imposing curbs on AI development, stating that such actions could stifle innovation. Trump's remarks suggest a stance against government intervention in the rapidly evolving AI sector, emphasizing its potential economic benefits.
